column_description: A unique identifier for each intake
Always true (to avoid this data accidentally being merged into non-synthetic intake logs)
Name of primary client, for public display purposes (typically first name plus last initial, separated by a space)
Age of primary client
Categorical, one of 'Single adult', 'Family with children', or 'Young adult' (chosen by Intake Specialist via single-choice dropdown box)
Integer, number of children under primary client's guardianship

Categorical, chosen via single-choice dropdown box by Intake Specialist. For example: 'Emergency Shelter', 'Halfway Home', or 'Women\'s Shelter' (but, could expand if the Department of Homeless Services establishes new types!)
One of 'Initial Intake' or 'Followup'
Day, month, and year of initial intake registration
Categorical, short (single-phrase) description of reason given, chosen via single-choice dropdown box by Intake Specialist. For example: 'Job loss' or 'Domestic violence safety concern'
Short (single-phrase) description of client-reported prior living situation, chosen via single-choice dropdown box by Intake Specialist. For example: 'Unsheltered' or 'Staying with friends'
Client-reported number of days during which they experienced housing instability (defined in the intake form documentation linked above) before coming to the shelter
Categorical, chosen via single-choice dropdown box by Intake Specialist. For example: 'Temporary employment', 'Unemployed', 'Not currently working', or 'Part-time employment'
Categorical, chosen via single-choice dropdown box by Intake Specialist. For example: 'Irregular income' or 'Public benefits reported'
Categorical, chosen via single-choice dropdown box by Intake Specialist. For example: 'Childcare and rent affordability', 'Safety and financial access'
Semicolon-delimited (elements separated by ';') list of needs checked by primary client on intake form. For example: 'transportation assistance; clothing'
Categorical, chosen via single-choice dropdown box by Intake Specialist, based on actionable steps between intake and followup. For example: 'employment services', 'housing search support'
Categorical, one of 'Discussed, not confirmed', 'Discussed, confirmed' (if primary client agrees to move forward), or 'Completed'
Categorical, short (one-phrase) summary of client-reported goals, chosen via single-choice dropdown box by Intake Specialist
Integer, number of days (chosen via single-choice dropdown box by Intake Specialist) allotted for carrying out referrals/client goals before followup appointment
Day, month, and year for scheduled followup appointment
Boolean: true if primary client\'s housing eligibility form has been verified by shelter staff, false otherwise
The length, in words, of the (plaintext) intake note for the entering individual or family
The plaintext intake note for the entering individual or family
A Base64-encoded image of the entering individual or family, taken at the time of intake
